response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (13+ years) generalist engineer with strong distributed-systems, low-latency, and event-driven exposure, plus a solid CS degree and clear communication/mentoring credentials. However, the role is fundamentally a C++ engineering position in industrial automation, and the resume shows only ~6 months of professional C/C++ work (National Instruments, 2014–2015) plus a university thesis — over a decade ago. There is no evidence of STL-heavy modern C++, IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle practice, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), MQTT, or Azure. The recent career trajectory (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, AI tooling) points away from the core requirement rather than toward it. Strong engineer, wrong specialization for this specific req.
strengths: 13+ years of experience with distributed, event-driven, low-latency systems at scale
Demonstrated engineering rigor: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools authored, workshops and mentoring
Broad polyglot depth including systems-level DLang work and embedded/desktop exposure
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++, dating back to 2014–2015
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL, MQTT, or fieldbus protocol experience
Recent work is web/cloud full-stack, indicating a trajectory away from the role's core

key_factors.factor: Industrial cybersecurity / IEC 62443 and automation domain gap
Distributed, event-driven systems and senior engineering maturity
